bibliographic.venue: International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research and Analysis
bibliographic.citation_apa: Omweri, F. S. (2024). Navigating the wicked policy problem: An in-depth analysis of policy dilemmas and innovative approaches for effective problem solving. International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research and Analysis, 7(3), 1196-1205. https://doi.org/10.47191/ijmra/v7-i03-42

methodology.method_family: narrative conceptual analysis of wicked policy problems
methodology.technology_context: public policy wicked problems; mentions data-driven decision-making and new information technologies in policy contexts without LLM or conversational AI

eligibility.exclusion_reason: No LLM, generative AI, conversational systems, chatbots, agents, RAG, or technical AI governance content; focus is public policy wicked problems and collaborative governance in government.
eligibility.decision_rationale: The article conceptually analyzes wicked policy problems and public-policy strategies such as policy networks, collaborative governance, policy entrepreneurship, decentralization, and street-level bureaucrats. Provided text contains no mention of large language models, generative AI, conversational interfaces, or governance mechanisms for AI systems in regulated technical environments. Governance matches are limited to public-administration and multi-level governance discourse.

appraisal.notes: Conceptual public-policy article without empirical design, sampling, or methods reporting. Not assessable as empirical evidence for LLM conversational governance; appraisal scores reflect only what is visible in the excerpted text.

cerqual.explanation: Although the article coherently discusses wicked policy problems and collaborative governance in public administration, it lacks relevance to LLM-based conversational systems and provides no empirical or technical governance evidence for the review scope.

coding.theme: Public policy approaches to wicked problems
coding.subtheme: Collaborative and networked governance in government

synthesis.main_claim: Wicked policy problems require an integrated, multifaceted, and adaptive policy package rather than a single problem-solving technique.
synthesis.contribution: Synthesizes public-policy strategies—including policy networks, collaborative governance, policy entrepreneurship, data-driven decision-making, policy diffusion, decentralization, and street-level bureaucrat placement—for addressing complex public-policy dilemmas.
synthesis.use_in_review: Exclude from central and supporting evidence because it does not address conversational AI, LLMs, or technical AI governance in regulated systems; at most distant contextual background on generic collaborative governance in public policy.
